stories.headline: Trump Cancels Evening Strikes on Iran — Dow +700, Oil Crashes From $98
stories.thesis: Trump called off evening strikes on Iran, triggering a massive peace rally: Dow +700, oil tumbled from $98 to $90. But the hidden consequence is that Trump's strike-on, strike-off posture has destroyed US deterrence credibility. Iran and UAE — a former US-Israeli coalition partner — are now negotiating face-to-face. The structural conditions (Hormuz disruption, US top oil exporter status) haven't changed. Only the headline did.

stories.headline: Iran and UAE Hold Face-to-Face Meeting — Diplomatic Earthquake in Persian Gulf
stories.thesis: Iran and the UAE held a face-to-face high-level meeting amid ongoing US military escalation in the Persian Gulf. The UAE was part of the US-Israeli coalition striking Iran. This meeting signals either a UAE defection from the coalition or a negotiated off-ramp that excludes the US. Either outcome degrades American regional leverage.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO Debuts Today at $1.8T — 91% Loss Margin Meets 'Hopes and Dreams'
stories.thesis: SpaceX lists on public markets today under ticker SPCX at a $1.8 trillion valuation. The company lost $4.28B on $4.69B revenue in Q1 2026 — a 91% loss margin. Barron's calls it 'hopes and dreams propping up markets.' If SPCX prices below $1.8T, it triggers a growth valuation regime shift that cascades through venture capital portfolios.

stories.headline: Prometheus, Bezos' AI Startup, Now Worth $41B — But Job Loss Fears Mount
stories.thesis: Jeff Bezos raised $12B for Prometheus, an industrial AI startup now valued at $41 billion. Bezos says AI brings 'golden ages,' not mass unemployment. But Anthropic CEO Amodei simultaneously warns of 25% unemployment requiring universal basic income. The gap between AI founders' public optimism and private contingency planning is the widest since the industrial revolution.

stories.headline: France and Germany Propose Stripping Top EU Diplomat Kallas of Powers
stories.thesis: France and Germany have proposed stripping the EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, of her foreign policy powers amid a rivalry with Commission President von der Leyen for control of EU foreign policy. Internal EU fragmentation accelerates as the bloc faces simultaneous crises on its eastern flank and in the Middle East.

stories.headline: US Becomes World's Top Oil Exporter as Hormuz Blockade Reshapes Energy Trade
stories.thesis: The Strait of Hormuz disruption has made the US the world's top oil exporter. European and Asian buyers are signing long-term US crude contracts. The DOE released 40M barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve. Trump cancelling strikes does not reverse the structural market share capture — the US is now the default supplier to allies who previously bought from Iran.

stories.headline: Musk Pitches Terafab Semiconductor Factory to ASML Ahead of SpaceX IPO
stories.thesis: Elon Musk addressed ASML employees to pitch his Terafab semiconductor factory concept ahead of the SpaceX IPO. The play: vertical integration of chip manufacturing for Starlink and autonomy compute. If Terafab attracts ASML partnership, it transforms SpaceX from a transportation company into a vertically integrated semiconductor player.
